name: @w6w-apps/activecampaign
description: Manage ActiveCampaign contacts, deals, campaigns and automations.

w6w.longDescription:
ActiveCampaign combines email marketing, CRM and marketing automation in one account, and this app gives a workflow a direct line into all three: create, update and remove contacts, create and track deals, and look up campaigns as they go out.

Automations stay something built in ActiveCampaign's own editor — the vendor's API doesn't allow creating or editing them — but a workflow can list existing automations and enroll a contact into one the moment some other system says they qualify, which covers the common case of triggering a sequence from an external event without duplicating its logic elsewhere.

Because ActiveCampaign issues each account its own API hostname rather than a single fixed endpoint, that address is collected once alongside the credential, so every action reaches the right account automatically and a workflow never has to track the URL itself.
